_readme: Running cost & CO2 calculator defaults (Premium feature 6, owner-approved 2026-09-29). ONE file for every market; read by src/hpiq/features/cost/CostPage.tsx through costModel.marketDefaults().
Every value is a public statistic with its source, URL and the period it refers to (asOf). All values are editable in the UI; the page says 'defaults as of <markets.XX.asOf>, edit to your tariff'.
REFRESH TWICE A YEAR (owner rule) — procedure and source list: docs/ENERGY_DEFAULTS.md. Bump markets.XX.asOf and version when you do.

Bases (keep consistent when refreshing): prices are ALL-IN household unit prices per kWh incl. taxes (standing-charge share as the source reports it); gas kWh and gas CO2 are on the GROSS calorific value (Hs / PCS / gross CV) basis — the one gas is billed on and boiler seasonal efficiency (EU 813/2013) is defined on; CO2 factors are direct (combustion/generation) CO2 unless the note says otherwise.
currency: GB -> GBP, PL -> PLN, others EUR (display only — this is not billing).

boilerEfficiency.source: EU 813/2013 seasonal space-heating efficiency (gross calorific value basis) — typical modern condensing gas boiler

buildingStandards.note: gas-heated single-family houses; gas consumption bands low / medium / elevated (65 / 127 / 220 kWh/m²·a) and the 1995–2001 age band (95) × 0.9 boiler efficiency, rounded — German stock; adjust for your climate

electricity.source: BDEW-Strompreisanalyse (household, 3,500 kWh/a, incl. taxes and standing-charge share)

heatPumpTariff.source: Verivox, Wärmepumpenstrom Preisentwicklung (new-customer heat-pump tariff, 7,500 kWh/a)
heatPumpTariff.note: Plus a base price of about 8–12 EUR/month for the separate meter — enter it as a negative standing-charge difference if relevant

gridCo2.source: Umweltbundesamt, Climate Change 16/2026 — CO2 emission factor of the German electricity mix (domestic consumption)
gridCo2.note: Direct CO2 of generation, no upstream chain

gasCo2.source: Umweltbundesamt CO2 emission factor natural gas (≈ 0.201 kg/kWh Hi), converted to Hs (÷ 1.11)
gasCo2.note: Combustion only. GEG Anlage 9 (0.240 kg CO2e/kWh Hi) includes the upstream chain

electricity.source: Ofgem energy price cap — GB average unit rate, Direct Debit
electricity.note: Standing charge 0.5483 GBP/day (not in the unit rate). Ofgem: no VAT on electricity 1 Oct 2026 – 31 Mar 2027

gas.source: Ofgem energy price cap — GB average unit rate, Direct Debit, incl. 5 % VAT
gas.note: Gas standing charge 0.2968 GBP/day (≈ 108 GBP/year) — enter it as the standing-charge difference if the gas supply is disconnected

gridCo2.source: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026 — UK electricity generation (0.13096) + transmission & distribution (0.01299)

gasCo2.source: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026 — natural gas, Scope 1, gross CV

electricity.source: Tarif réglementé de vente d'électricité (Tarif Bleu, option Base, 6 kVA, TTC) — CRE délibération n° 2026-147
electricity.note: Subscription ≈ 15.86 EUR/month (6 kVA) not included. Eurostat 2025-S2 all-in cross-check: 0.256

gas.source: CRE — prix repère de vente de gaz naturel, clients résidentiels chauffage (TTC)
gas.note: Subscription ≈ 361 EUR/year not included (Sep 2026: 0.1347). Eurostat 2025-S2 cross-check: 0.144

gridCo2.source: ADEME / RE2020 & DPE — CO2 content of electricity used for space heating
gridCo2.note: Seasonal heating-use value (lifecycle basis), higher than the annual average mix

gasCo2.source: ADEME Base Empreinte — natural gas 0.227 kg CO2e/kWh PCI (combustion + upstream), converted to PCS (÷ 1.11)
gasCo2.note: Lifecycle basis, consistent with the electricity factor above

electricity.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_204 — household electricity, 2,500–4,999 kWh/a, all taxes and levies included
electricity.note: The statutory price freeze ended 31 Dec 2025; 2026 G11 all-in offers are ~1.18–1.32 PLN/kWh depending on the DSO (URE tariffs)

gas.source: URE-approved myORLEN (PGNiG OD) tariff W-3.6: gas fuel 197.29 PLN/MWh net (≈ 0.243 PLN/kWh gross) plus PSG distribution and VAT
gas.note: All-in value is the midpoint of the 0.35–0.42 PLN/kWh range for fuel + distribution + VAT; Eurostat withholds the PL household gas price (confidential). Check against the customer's bill

gridCo2.source: KOBiZE — Wskaźniki emisyjności CO2 … dla energii elektrycznej u odbiorców końcowych (Dec 2025, Table 2)
gridCo2.note: Final consumers, incl. renewables and grid losses

gasCo2.source: KOBiZE — natural gas emission factor 56.10 kg CO2/GJ (≈ 0.202 kg/kWh Hi), converted to Hs (÷ 1.11)

electricity.source: ARERA — reference price for vulnerable customers, typical household 2,700 kWh/a, 3 kW, taxes included

gas.source: ARERA — reference price for vulnerable customers, 1,400 Smc/a: 1.4372 EUR/Smc, converted with PCS 0.03852 GJ/Smc (10.70 kWh/Smc)

gridCo2.source: ISPRA Rapporto 430/2026 — CO2 emission factor of electricity consumption

gasCo2.source: ISPRA — national natural gas emission factor 56.79 t CO2/TJ (0.2044 kg/kWh Hi), converted to Hs (÷ 1.11)
